Title: The #1 Cause of Vertigo (And the Habits Behind It)

Description:
Roughly 1 in 40 people will deal with BPPV at some point - it's the single most common cause of vertigo. It happens when tiny calcium crystals in your inner ear drift into the canals that control balance, triggering brief spinning spells when you move your head a certain way.

Low vitamin D, long stretches of sitting or lying still, and poor sleep quality (trouble falling or staying asleep) are all risk factors linked to getting BPPV and having it come back, according to research on this common form of vertigo.

None of these guarantee you'll avoid it, but they're worth building into your routine - and recurring spinning is worth getting checked out too.
